AboutPage.title: About
AboutPage.name: Aliou Wade
AboutPage.bio: I specialize in operational software — the systems that keep businesses running: internal tools, admin workflows, CRM consolidation, ERP configuration. I don't build marketing sites. I build the infrastructure behind them — CRMs, customer apps, acceptance test suites, admin systems, workflow automation. I work in French and English, and I build for operational realities that most software ignores.
AboutPage.context: I play chess — not competitively, but it shapes how I think about systems: patience, positional tradeoffs, playing the long game. I came up as an operator, not an academic. I've run a bakery logistics chain, built carpooling coordination tools, and shipped software that businesses depend on daily. That operational context is what I bring to every system I build.
